summary: {member} needs to vote from wherever there is a free seat in the chamber.
realLife: Anderson explained why a fixed switch at each lawmaker's desk would not suit the House and how personal cards that worked at any station answered the problem. When the panel covering a run of surnames failed on February 10, 2000, the chair asked those members to check their votes at a station. The desk reported that votes from that section were being recorded.
inGame: needs: the seating arrangement and the voting equipment.

turns.what: The member uses their card there.

turns.pulledBy: The row has no available station.
turns.what: The member moves to another row.
turns.writesBack: The vote waits until a station is reached.
